    Parlor Palm Information

    About The Parlor Palm

    The Parlor Palm is a favorite easy-care palm with tropical fronds known for its air-purifying qualities.

    • Each plant is unique; size and shape fluctuate by season so all measurements are shown as a range
    • Small plant measures between 6–11 inches tall from bottom of the grow pot to the top of the foliage
    • Medium plant measures between 12-18 inches tall from bottom of the grow pot to the top of the foliage
    • Large plant measures between 3-4 feet tall from bottom of the grow pot to the top of the foliage
    • Arrives in a nursery grow pot nestled in your planter choice
    Sizing Guide
    Small
    Approximately 5" in diameter, fits plants in a 4" grow pot or smaller
    Medium
    Approximately 7" in diameter, fits plants in a 6" grow pot or smaller
    Large
    Approximately 10-12" in diameter, fits plants in a 10" grow pot or smaller
    Massive
    Approximately 12-14" in diameter, fits plants in a 12" grow pot or smaller
    Watering Requirements
    Water every 1-2 weeks, allowing soil to mostly dry out between waterings. Expect to water more often in brighter light and less often in lower light.
    Sunlight Requirements
    Thrives in medium to bright indirect light, but can tolerate low indirect light. Not suited for intense, direct sun.
    Humidity Requirements
    Palms prefer higher humidity if possible, preferably above 40%. Consider incorporating a humidifier to boost humidity levels more consistently if the air in the home is dry.
    Pet-Friendly Plant?
    Yes, this plant is safe for homes with pets.
    Read our full care guide
    Frequently Asked Questions
    Is the Parlor Palm a good choice for beginners?
    Yes! The Parlor Palm is widely considered the absolute best starter palm for beginners. It is incredibly resilient, adapts effortlessly to average indoor humidity, and handles a bit of watering neglect without flinching.

    Yes! The Parlor Palm is widely considered the absolute best starter palm for beginners. It is incredibly resilient, adapts effortlessly to average indoor humidity, and handles a bit of watering neglect without flinching.
    Can a Parlor Palm live in a room with low light?
    Yes! The Parlor Palm handles low to medium indirect light effortlessly, making it perfect for apartments or office desks.
    Can a Parlor Palm live in a room with low light?
    Yes! The Parlor Palm handles low to medium indirect light effortlessly, making it perfect for apartments or office desks.
    Why is my Parlor Palm turning brown?
    If leaves are turning brown and crispy, it is usually caused by underwatering or low humidity. However, if you only see a brown leaf popping up here and there on the very bottom of the plant, this is just natural leaf loss as the older foliage matures and dies off.
